text:
Carol: Starting geo wave 3 today — plan is US -> EU -> APAC, 3% canary then 10% then 50%, warm pools in each region. Pinning versions as we go.
Sam (deploybot): deploybot: canary start: region=us pct=3 version=v23.5.0-tagged image=redwood/infer:v23.5.0 ts=1719004567
Maria: Quick ask — what's the current warm pool capacity in EU? want to avoid backfill during canary.
Deepak: EU warm pool: 180 instances ready (target 200), avg startup < 45s. Baseline RPS for EU slice: 2.1k.
Olivia: If EU is short, can we borrow a 20-node cushion from US warm pool for the first 10m?
ops-oncall: We can soft-lend 20, but ops will trigger drain rules if p99 starts >700ms.
Carol: OK keep EU pinned to v23.4.9 until we confirm warm pool + smoke. We only unpin after EU 10% verifies for 15m.
Sam (deploybot): deploybot: pinned-region: eu -> v23.4.9 (requested by Carol)
Maria: Starting smoke tests against EU canary now. Running these checks: health, latency, error-rate, kv-cache hit ratio.
Maria: smoke result snippet:
```
health: OK
p50: 42ms
p95: 180ms
p99: 510ms
error_rate: 0.6% (inbound token decode)
kv_hit_ratio: 73%
```
Deepak: Those numbers look fine. p99 under 600ms, error_rate < 1% — pass for canary progression.
Olivia: Two small notes: memory pressure on EU-gpu-batch-3 node group spiked once (OOM warning) at 12:12UTC — tracked to a large customer batch. ops-oncall: we saw a transient OOM log, but no pod restarts. We'll keep a 10m watch.
Carol: Thumbs up on progressing to EU 10% but hold APAC until EU 10% stable for 15m. I'll update release notes with pin/unpin steps.
Sam (deploybot): deploybot: canary update: region=eu pct=10 -> version=v23.5.0 staged ts=1719004700
Maria: Running the 10% load test now (synthetic mix). Observing small increase in latency — p99 ~ 620ms for a minute then back to ~480ms. Error_rate steady ~0.8%.
Deepak: Set metric guardrails in case: rollback if error_rate >= 2% for 5m OR p99 >= 750ms for 3m OR GPU OOM restarts >= 3 in 10m.
ops-oncall: I'll attach alerts to that rule and stand by for manual rollback if triggered.
Olivia: Also adding a temporary routing policy to divert 20% of EU traffic to dedicated pool if it spikes.
Carol: Release note snippet for customers: "v23.5.0 staged deployment — progressive regional rollout; EU remains pinned to v23.4.9 until successful 10% validation; expected APAC rollout after EU stabilization."
Sam (deploybot): deploybot: eu 10% smoke passed initial 15m window. No rollback triggers. next action: allow unpin at 1719005600 unless objections.
Maria: No objections. Suggest we keep a two-hour ramp window for APAC since their seq lengths are longer and KV hit differs.
Deepak: Agree — APAC slower sequences, recommend warmup of +30% cache retention and 15m lower concurrency initial slice.
Carol: Fine. I'll schedule APAC canary for +30m to allow EU warm pool to top-up and for ops to clear the watch.
ops-oncall: We'll monitor the deploy logs and OOMs; ping if any deviation.
Sam (deploybot): deploybot: scheduled: apac canary at ts=1719006780 pct=3 version=v23.5.0
Carol: Thanks team. If anyone sees p99 >= 700ms in EU within next 30m, call rollback and re-pin EU immediately. :bell:
Maria: Noted. I'll attach the smoke test dashboard link in a follow-up thread.
Deepak: After APAC ramp, let's run a short A/B eval comparing embeddings quality across v23.4.9 vs v23.5.0 on a reserved prompt set. If regression > 1% we'll pause rollouts.
Olivia: ack. I'll prepare the eval job.
Sam (deploybot): deploybot: thread closed for now; will post updates as canary events happen.
Carol: Closing notes: Rollback playbook: 1) pin region to previous stable 2) open rollback incident channel 3) revert routing to dedicated fallback 4) trigger quick rollback pipeline. Keep this thread as single source of truth for the rollout status."
